created_by: ChatGPT: implementation and structural review; no independent human review

definition_defaults.evidence_requirement: A typed predicate does not establish a fact. Review each attestation and its exact source locator separately.

relations.definition: Agent authored the work; does not entail sole authorship or any wider creation claim.
Work presents the indicated intellectual content. Does not imply endorsement or truth of that content.
Theory or model concerns the referent. This is aboutness, not a claim of explanatory success.
Theory contains the stated law as an intellectual component; no physical-containment inference.
Agent contributed substantively to development of the object; no claim of sole creation or invention.
Framework predicts a phenomenon or proposition within an explicit scope. Prediction alone is not observation or verification.
A weak association was asserted. No causation, equivalence, transitivity or automatic reverse assertion is licensed.
Subject influenced object in an attributed historical or intellectual context. Chained edges do not establish a further influence.
Subject contributed to the emergence of an outcome, not necessarily alone and not necessarily as an inventor.
Preserves the source's invention assertion. Disputed or broad invention claims are not rewritten into contribution claims.
Work depicts its subject, possibly under an attributed interpretation; depiction is not endorsement.
A specified passage of a specified document expresses the proposition. Does not entail that the proposition is true, implemented, legally effective today, or endorsed by this project.
Evidence is assessed as supporting the target proposition. Not social support, institutional protection or a truth guarantee.
Evidence is assessed as challenging the target proposition. Not political opposition and not necessarily a logical contradiction.

patterns.definition: Keep framework, represented subject and representational medium distinct.
Separate succession, generality and approximation; do not invent a validity regime.
An emergence claim needs its process and context rather than a sole-origin inference.
Item/category classification must retain evaluator, criterion version and distinct subject/assertion times.
Editorial grouping does not entail subclass, instance or part-whole relations.
Do not infer the characterization category from the framework's name.
A lexical sense record is not identical to its referent. Preserve the sense qualifier without silently creating that record.
